commands.name: browse-spaces
commands.title: Browse Spaces
commands.subtitle: mymind
commands.description: Browse your mymind spaces and the cards inside them

commands.name: browse-tags
commands.title: Browse Tags

commands.name: save-to-mymind
commands.title: Save to mymind

commands.title: mymind Menu Bar

tools.name: search-mymind
tools.title: Search mymind
tools.description: Search the user's mymind library by query, returning the top matches with title, source URL, tags, and modified date.

tools.name: save-url-to-mymind
tools.title: Save URL to mymind
tools.description: Save a remote URL to mymind. mymind fetches and enriches the page automatically.

tools.name: save-note-to-mymind
tools.title: Save Note to mymind
tools.description: Save a markdown note to mymind.

tools.name: list-mymind-tags
tools.title: List mymind Tags
tools.description: List the user's mymind tags, most recently used first.

tools.name: list-mymind-spaces
tools.title: List mymind Spaces
tools.description: List the user's mymind spaces with names, colors, and object counts.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

preferences.name: keyId
preferences.title: Access Key ID
preferences.description: The Key ID from your mymind access key. Generate one at https://access.mymind.com/api

preferences.name: secretKey
preferences.title: Access Key Secret
preferences.description: The private key (HS256 secret) shown when you created the access key. Shown only once — keep it safe.
